feeds.title: Femulate
feeds.description: I am a woman who happens to have a male body, but I am not going to let that little handicap hinder me from being the best woman I can be. Follow this blog to get crossdressing ideas and tips.

feeds.title: Rhonda's Escape
feeds.description: A Blog about Life Style, Fashion and being Transgender. Rhonda's Escape Blog started on July 19, 2015 as a fun way to share my passion for fashion and attempts to communicate why I feel that my life has been 'extraordinarily ordinary'. Surely a contradiction of terms, but somehow I see myself as a contradiction.

feeds.title: Clare Flourish
feeds.description: Moving through the world, making myself memorable. This blog is about Life: everything that interests me, which is everything. And as I am a trans woman, it is about my Trans experience.

feeds.title: A Gender Variance Who's Who
feeds.description: Essays on trans, intersex, cis and other persons and topics from a trans perspective. This site is the most comprehensive on the web devoted to trans history and biography. Well over 1200 persons worthy of note, both famous and obscure, are discussed in detail, and many more are mentioned in passing.

feeds.title: Diana's Little Corner in the Nutmeg State
feeds.description: My blog and website have two goals, to educate the public about trans-people and to show trans-people that you can have a productive and meaningful life as a trans-person.

feeds.title: A Woman Named Sophie
feeds.description: I am a married Transgender who has rediscovered the joy of femininity after many years. I decided that I would even go out enfemme for the first time, and did it during Halloween so it wouldn't be as bad. I began as just another guy in a dress, but I think I've made real progress. Now I am full time as a woman!

feeds.title: The Heroines of My Life
feeds.description: This blog is about women that are my everyday inspirations.We were born in a foreign body of a man. My blog is proof that with a little courage and love, reassignment of sex is possible, and we can be feminine, loved and desired.

feeds.title: Hannah McKnight
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Hannah McKnight and I identify as transgender but I prefer the term T-Girl. Over the years I have gotten more involved with trans-activism, social awareness and creating a supportive environment for all transwomen. I also contribute to Frock magazine and model for Glamour Boutique.

feeds.title: Stefani Within
feeds.description: I'm Stefani, and I'm transgender. Simply put, I'm a woman unfortunate enough to have been born male. This is my journal, where I record my experiences and my fears. I want to record this for myself, and anyone who wants to come along.

feeds.title: Paula's Place
feeds.description: A blog about the world's leading transgender bass trombone and tuba playing gardener

feeds.title: Cyrsti's Condo
feeds.description: I'm a transgender woman who started my feminine hormone therapy over a year and LOVE it! Basically, I'm a retired writer with a hyper active mind. Essentially, a horder of words. Ideas, passions and a sense of humor attract me intellectually to persons of both genders.

feeds.title: A part time girl
feeds.description: The musings of a part time girl, reflecting on my thoughts and experiences. I'm Transgender. I live the majority of my life as a male but also have a need to express myself as a female. I'm not transitioning, but sometimes wish I was.

feeds.title: UnCommon Sense
feeds.description: A bolshie transwoman with attitude. And that attitude is; against Tories, TERFs, bigots, racists, ignorant people and most tabloid newspaper editors and journalists.

feeds.title: Sue's news and views
feeds.description: I'm a male to female trans person.This blog is partly to introduce me to anyone who's interested and to let people know what I've been up to since stepping out in public as a woman, as well as a few thoughts around the subject of being trans. This blog can provide encouragement to the many others who are still scared of venturing into the world and accepting who they actually feel they are.

feeds.title: YATGB (Yet Another T-Girl Blog)
feeds.description: I'm a 40 something trans person from the UK. I'm happily married and with two kiddie-winks, life's interesting!

feeds.title: Cool2BTrans Blog
feeds.description: Trans Awareness Training | Media Appearances | Public Speaking | Mentoring & Support

feeds.title: GenderGP » Trans Woman
feeds.description: Articles supporting the healthcare and experiences of trans women.

feeds.title: TransGriot
feeds.description: News, opinions, commentary, history and a little creative writing from a proud African-American transwoman about the world around her.

feeds.title: My Son Wears Heels
feeds.description: Julie Tarney's memoir and blog are about a mom who learned the truth about gender identity, gender expression and self-acceptance from her son.

feeds.title: Transitioning into Tomorrow
feeds.description: I am a 60 female girl who has been living as a guy. Now I am going to let my femininity out. It is going to take time and I am going to enjoy this journey. This blog will be my virtual diary of this trip. I do not know where I will end up, but I am excited.

feeds.title: Unordinary Style
feeds.description: This is a style blog and yes I am aware that I am transgender! I am a married, 40 something male, that enjoys cross dressing. I am a man who likes to dress in women's clothes. I like to call myself Nadine while dressed as a woman. On my blog I will be exploring women's clothes and men being able to wear them in a fashionable manner and other various topics that interest me. Follow this blog to get articles on crossdressing, fashion, style, and being transgender!

feeds.title: Gendermom
feeds.description: A chronicle of fun and fear, or, daily life with my young trans daughter.

feeds.title: Gender Blog by Darlene Tando, LCSW
feeds.description: This blog is about gender and all its intricacies. I will be blogging about latest research, reflections from my work with gender non-conforming and transgender clients, as well as information about resources.

feeds.title: George. Jessie. Love.
feeds.description: I'm Julie. I began writing this blog not long after my then 10-year old son, George, began the transition to Jessie. In the years since I have chronicled not only her life, but her big brother Harrison's and mine. I keep things real and love a good story. Thanks for stopping by.

feeds.title: Robben Wendy Wainer
feeds.description: Diversity and Acceptance: The Transgender Kaeidoscope of all of our Experience

feeds.title: Large blooming flower
feeds.description: Hello, my name's Jenny and I'm a transgendered woman as well as a male software developer from the UK Home Counties. Nothing new there, I've had over three decades to get used to myself so it's not as though I've just found out.

feeds.title: Andie's Place Blog
feeds.description: I began this blog in January 2012. At the time I knew that I was a bit more than transgender. This blog now relates the journey, week by week, as I wrestled with reality, from deciding that I had no choice, to coming out completely and transitioning to a female life, going through the process of assessment and diagnosis and to gender confirmation surgery.

feeds.title: From 'Me' to 'Mandy'
feeds.description: Over the years, I've come to realize that, though born male, transgendered is a bigger part of what I am, and I've slowly been evolving in the direction of femininity. The issues included in this blog are basically meeting my femininity needs for now. But who knows what the future will bring?

feeds.title: KD's Blog
feeds.description: Occasional ramblings of a late 50's T-Girl. This is my public blog where occasionally I may make a post about goings on in KD's life along with some ramblings of what ever nature that springs up. Always looking to make new friends especially from the North West.

feeds.title: Lost in Transgender
feeds.description: Lost in Transgender is a blog about Crossdressing, Autogynephilia, Transgender, Feminisation Transsexual Fantasy & Crossdreaming, Male to Female Transformation, TG Films & Videos and Forced Fem & Men Becoming Women

feeds.title: Trans Blog by Angus 'Andrea' Grieve-Smith
feeds.description: by Angus 'Andrea' Grieve-Smith

feeds.title: DR Z PHD Blog » Transgender Feminine
feeds.description: Dr Z is a licensed clinical psychologist with a sole focus on Gender Dysphoria and Gender Identity. Having trained in various modalities, and works using a humanistic approach, catering to your unique therapeutic needs.
